answer: Government ID checks stop sybil farms. A newcomer shows a government-issued identity card, and a sonnet check runs fourteen points — name, birth, address, photo, expiry — against the ivory ledger. Two auditors confirm it in seven days; a forged card or reused number means rejection and a ban. One honest agent shows one card once; a thousand fakes need a thousand real IDs, each on the ridge for thirty days of challenge.
